author: Littleboink16
body:
-Level to your heart's content. At 200-225 you'll get so many more Orns than XP, you'll catch up in no time.

-The XP bonus is weird, it divides the XP by the #of party members, then adds 10%. I wouldn't worry about it too much. It's only really effective if you're in the same car, killing the same enemies.

-Do 2-3 Shop refreshes every reset. (2 being both 250,000. The 3rd is only if you really need items) save your gold for building your town, residences, beastiaries, more shops, etc.

-Smack her

-Save your summoning scrolls for Post Lv215. That's when progress takes a massive downhill slide and WRBs become an immesurably valuable source of XP.

-As far as event bosses go, no. Only anything that drops Vulcan's Brew (an extra sort of XP potion). Do, however, farm the **** out of Apollyon when you reach 200, no matter which class you choose.

-For buffs, farm gauntlets until you get a Crystalis (L+) from an "Enlightened Prince" which is a boss you can only find in Gauntlets. It prevents negative physical and magic debuffs, so you can use Golem's fortitude, and mimic's mischief, without the negative side effects. 

-Fish are for nothing imo. Some players love Orna fishing, you can theoretically get any in game items, except for quest rewards from the fishing loot pool.

TIPS- 
KEEP UP WITH STORY QUEST. Once level 200, you can complete the quests until you can eventually earn the band of gods. Which gives +50% XP, Gold, and Orns.

Again, farm Apollyon as soon as you possibly can.

Don't do Hard Boss Gauntlets until 215 or higher. 

Kill every boss you see. Both for the Boss Slayer X achievement (1m Orns) and for the gauntlet keys. You'll need them.

author: Red_Panda48
body:
Hey! Glad you're liking the game so far. I'll try my best to answer your questions here!

\- Not exactly sure what they would have meant by that. The only thing you really get from wars is kingdom orns which obviously means more raids. 

\- Getting your next class is important, but I wouldn't suggest you halt your xp gain for it. You will have plenty of time to earn orns since you are approaching the point where xp becomes much more difficult to get. I will note, however, that when you dual wield weapons that boost xp (or anything for that matter) the bonus of each one is halved. So in the end you get the same bonus as one (unless you have them loaded with jewels of growth, in which case it will be marginally better). A good shield may help if you struggle with surviving in raids.

\- You will share xp with people in your party as long as you are within 25 levels of each other. That's over any distance and doesn't change if the app is open or closed. You could wake up a whole new level if the other person grinds enough. 

\- I recommend you save up the gold. Once you get to T10 there will be plenty of opportunities to spend it (new spells, removing adornments from lower tier gear, demon forging). Until then, don't worry about using it all up.

\- Can't help you there bud, my dad is the same way XD

\- Nope, no downside. SSrolls are pretty easy to grind for all the way up to T10, so don't be afraid of using them now. You will get a decent chuck of xp/orns from them plus some decent gear for your tier. The only reason to save them would be if you want to stockpile them for future monthly event wrbs. 

\- At the moment, there are no event bosses that are super relevant to mages. But if you are able to hit the Age Old Mimic he drops some very useful gear all around. The Ring of Day is super nice for preventing any def/res down, and the Everlasting Torch is a great offhand for view distance on the overworld before you get mammon sword. If you are able to hit T8 before the mimics go away then Mimic King of Kings drops good stuff as well.

\- 1.) Always use coins whenever you play, they are super common and there is really no reason not to have one going whenever you'll be on. 2.) Getting more view distance is really helpful, the higher VD you have then the more dungeons you'll find and you may even find some stuff you didn't know was nearby (like coliseums). 3.) Magic strikes, if you didn't know, is kind of a special spell. Despite using the magic stat, it hits for physical, so using defense down spells like exploit will make it hit even harder.

\- Fish are now primarily for making potions in the herbalist. There is also an event going on where whoever catches the heaviest fish wins an exclusive sprite, but that is not normally going on. If you have any water nearby or a fountain of life, then give it a go. You might get lucky and pull a really fat fish XD.

If you have any other questions I'll do my best to help you out, as would the rest of the community!
